title: The Unbounce Landing Pages plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting in… (CVE-2026-107632)
description: The Unbounce Landing Pages plugin for WordPress versions up to and including 1.1.6 contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability. This occurs because unauthenticated attacker-controlled input is stored without proper sanitization and later rendered in the admin diagnostics page, allowing script execution in the context of an administrator viewing that page.
